limitations: Resources and raw durations describe only these two profiled events.
No collector timing, throughput or speedup is accepted; output correctness comes from separate retained files.
This new host packaging performs one launch per variant; the earlier repeated-launch protocol and binary are not treated as identical.
Source function continuity alone does not establish binary, instrumentation or device-state identity.
Input snapshots describe their capture boundaries, not transient inputs inside a kernel.
Numerical failures remain failures under the unchanged exact oracle; no tolerance or performance acceptance is introduced.
